job.description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.
We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.
Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.
Taking ownership and driving impact
Being open to change and feedback
Being passionate about our mission and our customers.
Your mission
Every designer at Catawiki shapes a meaningful part of the customer experience.
In Seller Experience, your mission is to make it easier for sellers to bring special objects to Catawiki and for our experts to select and curate them. You will improve the experiences and tools that help sellers get started, submit objects and work with our experts.The seller journey is closely connected to the quality of the objects buyers discover on Catawiki. You will work across that journey to understand where people need support, identify the most valuable design opportunities and create experiences that work for customers, the business and the technology behind them.
You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data and other designers. From research and early concepts through prototyping, delivery and learning after launch, you will help the team turn complex problems into clear, useful experiences.
What You Will Do
Lead design for important parts of the seller and expert experience, from early discovery through launch and improvement.
Use customer research, behavioural data and business insight to identify needs and design opportunities.
Turn ambiguous customer problems into clear journeys, concepts, prototypes and design plans.
Explore and test ideas with customers and colleagues, using what you learn to improve the experience.
Create thoughtful interaction and interface designs, prototypes and service flows that make complex tasks clear and intuitive.
Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, UX Writers and other designers to shape and deliver solutions.
Connect customer needs with business goals and technical constraints, helping the team make sound tradeoffs.
Contribute to design systems and shared patterns that create coherent experiences across Catawiki.
Share your design rationale, bring feedback into the process and help stakeholders reach clear decisions.
Use AI and rapid prototyping tools to explore ideas and test assumptions when they help solve a meaningful customer problem.
Who You Are
Customer understanding: You are curious about what people need and why. You use research, data and direct feedback to understand the problem before settling on a solution.
Systems thinking: You understand how seller tools, expert workflows, object quality and the buyer experience influence one another. You can make thoughtful design decisions across the wider journey.
Design judgement: You bring clarity to complex experiences. You care about craft and can balance usability, business needs and technical constraints.
You Will Also Bring
At least five years of experience designing digital products, ideally in ecommerce, marketplaces or another product used directly by customers.
A portfolio that shows how you approached complex problems, improved experiences and contributed to results.
Strong skills in interaction design, prototyping and visual communication.
Experience conducting or contributing to customer research and translating what you learn into design decisions.
Confidence working with Product Managers, Engineers and other partners in a cross functional team.
Fluency with Figma and prototyping tools.
An understanding of design systems and how to use and improve shared patterns.
Clear communication skills and the ability to explain your thinking to different audiences.
A degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
Where you will be
This role is based in Amsterdam with a hybrid working arrangement with 2 fixed days per week in the office. We offer a relocation package for people currently living outside the Netherlands.
Why You'll Love Working with Us
Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.
Our Offices and Way of Working
Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.
Interested?
Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯
Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! This is a hands-on, mobile-first role focused on solving complex UX challenges in a high-traffic, real-time consumer environment.
We believe AI is transforming how great products are designed. That's why we're looking for designers who already integrate AI into their day-to-day practice using it to explore ideas faster, prototype smarter, automate repetitive work and collaborate more effectively with engineers while maintaining a high standard of craft and product thinking.
YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥
In this role, your main missions will be:
🏟️ Sports Product squad
This squad focuses on the core Sports experience:
Sports navigation and discovery
Betting journeys and offers
Match pages and live experiences
Complex user flows, edge cases and real-time constraints
Using product data and insights to understand user behaviour, identify friction points and inform design decisions

Design new features based on user research, analytics, business objectives and product strategy
Simplify and optimise complex user journeys while ensuring clarity, consistency and usability
Own the end-to-end user experience for your product scope, from discovery to delivery
Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the product lifecycle
Lead or contribute to discovery workshops, ideation sessions and usability testing
Create wireframes, mockups and interactive prototypes using Figma
Contribute to and continuously improve our Design System
Leverage AI throughout the design process to accelerate exploration, research synthesis, prototyping, production and iteration
Experiment with AI-enabled workflows, design agents and design-to-code approaches to continuously improve the way we build products
Help shape how AI becomes part of Betclic's Product Design practice by testing new tools, sharing learnings and evolving team workflows
Stay current with product design, UX/UI and AI-enabled design practices
How We Think About Ai 🤖
AI is becoming an essential part of modern product design not as a replacement for craft, but as a way to work faster, explore more ideas and spend more time solving meaningful user problems.
At Betclic, we're actively evolving our design practice by experimenting with AI-assisted workflows, design agents and design-to-code collaboration. We're looking for designers who are excited to help shape this evolution through curiosity, experimentation and continuous learning.
WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍
We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm!
This job is for you if:
You have 8+ years of experience as a Product Designer or Senior Product Designer
You have a strong hands-on background designing mobile-first B2C products
You enjoy solving complex UX challenges involving logic, edge cases and sophisticated user journeys
You are comfortable owning product problems from discovery through delivery
You collaborate naturally with Product Managers and Engineers in mature cross-functional teams
You already use AI regularly in your design workflow to accelerate exploration, synthesis, prototyping or implementation
You are curious about emerging AI capabilities and enjoy experimenting with new ways of designing and building products
You understand how AI can enhance product thinking, design craft and engineering collaboration not just generate visuals
You have high standards for execution, craft and attention to detail
You have a strong interest in Sports (you don't need betting experience, but curiosity and affinity matter)
You are fluent in both French and English
NICE TO HAVES 🎯
We're particularly interested if you have experience with:
Product
Gamification, engagement or retention mechanics
Sports, gaming or mobile gaming products
Regulated consumer products
Design systems and scalable UI patterns
Data-informed design, experimentation and analytics
AI & Emerging Design Workflows
Experience with some of the following is a plus:
Figma AI
AI-assisted design workflows
Design agents
Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Context engineering
Design-to-code workflows
React, SwiftUI, Flutter or HTML/CSS generation
Cursor
Claude
Lovable
AI-powered research synthesis

WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝
If your application is shortlisted, our recruiter will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning).
About two weeks later, you will either take a technical test with one of our design experts or work on a case study to present to the team.
Next, you will meet your future manager, followed by a member of the Executive or Management Committee.
Finally, the recruiter will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together.
The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you.

🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life

About The Role
Most teams use AI as a faster way for humans to build products. At Deel, we want to go further: build the system that lets AI build the products, with humans defining the taste, the guardrails, and the standards it works within.
That system is your product. You design and build the substrate AI generates against: the design system and component architecture, the generation and agent workflows, the quality gates that keep AI output production-ready, and the feedback loops that keep everything visible to the team. You stay hands-on as a designer throughout, because the fastest way to prove a generation system works is to design and ship real interfaces on top of it.
This is a senior individual contributor role. It is systems-first and craft-backed: you build the machine, and you use your own design ability to pressure-test it. You spend your time in Figma and in a code editor in roughly equal measure, you partner directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you work as part of a cross-functional team alongside Engineering and Product rather than in isolation.

Drive the AI workflow across the design org - Partner directly with design leadership to maintain, evolve, and roll out the AI-native workflow across the whole design organisation, not just your own work. This is a shared, ongoing responsibility, not a one-off setup: driving adoption, keeping standards current as tools change, and embedding the workflow across teams so it never depends on one person.
Work cross-functionally - Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, and design-system contributors. You complement engineering rather than replacing it, and you keep the system round-tripping to shared surfaces such as Figma so AI-accelerated output stays visible and open to feedback, never a black box.
Push into generative UI - Take AI beyond the build process and into the product itself. Prototype and evaluate adaptive, AI-generated interfaces as a product capability, and help shape where they belong on the roadmap.
Level up the team - Turn what works into playbooks, prompt libraries, and enablement so the wider design org builds on the system rather than depending on you. The goal is durable capability, not tool dependency.

Samen met onze UX/UI Designer en Customer Journey-specialisten werk je aan het creëren en continu verbeteren van de digitale ervaring van ON THAT ASS-members. Je krijgt energie van het verbeteren van de customer journey. Van kleine aanpassingen die direct resultaat opleveren tot grotere verbeteringen die onze digitale omgeving naar een hoger niveau tillen. Zo draag je met jouw werk bij aan een betere member experience en de verdere groei van ON THAT ASS.

Je onderzoekt en brengt gebruikersbehoeften in kaart en vertaalt deze naar gebruiksvriendelijke ontwerpen voor onze digitale platforms.
Je analyseert knelpunten in de customer journey, ontdekt verbeterkansen en signaleert commerciële mogelijkheden waarop we snel kunnen inspelen.
Je ontwikkelt wireframes, prototypes en high-fidelity designs in Figma voor onze websites en accountomgevingen.
Je helpt mee met het verder ontwikkelen en verbeteren van ons bestaande design system, zodat we consistent en efficiënt kunnen blijven ontwerpen.
Je bent medeverantwoordelijk voor het CRO-proces en werkt aan creatieve experimenten en A/B-testen om onze conversie te verhogen.
Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van onder andere Customer Journey, CRM, IT en Data om ideeën om te zetten in concrete verbeteringen.
Je kijkt verder dan alleen onze website en zet jouw UX-kennis in om de volledige customer journey te verbeteren. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan e-mails, social ads en ons loyaltyplatform.
Je zet AI-tools slim in binnen je designproces om sneller van idee naar een sterk ontwerp te komen.

Jij bent een UX/UI Designer met een sterk gevoel voor design en een goed begrip van gebruikersgedrag. Figma kent voor jou weinig geheimen en je weet hoe je een aantrekkelijk ontwerp combineert met een prettige en logische gebruikerservaring.
Je kijkt verder dan alleen het visuele aspect. Je wilt begrijpen waarom members bepaalde keuzes maken, waar ze afhaken en hoe je met slimme verbeteringen het verschil kunt maken. Daarbij combineer je creativiteit met een commerciële blik en durf je bestaande oplossingen kritisch te bekijken.

Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als UX/UI Designer, bij voorkeur binnen een e-commerceomgeving.
Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau.

Bij ON THAT ASS krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis, creativiteit en ideeën in te zetten om onze digitale member experience iedere dag een beetje beter te maken.

Een salaris tussen de € 3.532 en € 5.294 bruto per maand, waarbij je op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring wordt ingedeeld in onze salarisschaal.

Dagelijks een heerlijke, volledig verzorgde lunch op kantoor.

Wil jij jouw creativiteit en UX/UI-kennis inzetten om de digitale ervaring van onze members naar een hoger niveau te tillen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!
